 Print The Bar Council of India will release the AIBE XXII admit card on November 14. Registered candidates can download their hall tickets online ahead of the November 29 examination. The Bar Council of India (BCI) is scheduled to release the All India Bar Examination (AIBE) 22 admit card tomorrow on November 14, 2026. Candidates who have registered for the examination will be able to access and download their hall tickets through the official website, allindiabarexamination.com. The AIBE XXII examination is scheduled to be conducted on November 29, 2026. With the examination date approaching, candidates should download their admit cards as soon as the link becomes active and verify the information printed on the document. The admit card is a compulsory document for entry into the examination centre. Candidates must carry a printed copy of the hall ticket on the examination day. Those who fail to produce the required admit card may be denied entry to the examination hall. AIBE 22 admit card 2026 release date and time
 The BCI has confirmed November 14, 2026, as the date for releasing the AIBE 22 admit card. However, the examination authority has not announced a specific time for activating the download link. Join conversation

 Candidates should regularly visit the official website for updates regarding the availability of the hall ticket. Once released, the admit card will be accessible online through the candidate login portal. Applicants are advised not to wait until the last few days before the examination to download the document. Early access will give them sufficient time to check their details and contact the examination authority in case of any discrepancy. AIBE 22 admit card 2026: Steps to download hall tickets
 Candidates can follow the steps elucidated here to download the AIBE 22 admit card 2026 from the official website: Visit the official website of the All India Bar Examination at allindiabarexamination.com.
 Look for the AIBE 22 admit card 2026 download link on the homepage.
 Click on the hall ticket link to proceed to the candidate login page.
 Enter the required credentials, including the application ID and password.
 Submit the login details to access the AIBE XXII admit card.
 The hall ticket will appear on the screen.
 Download the PDF and take a clear printout for use on the examination day.
 Candidates are advised to stay tuned to the official website to get the complete details of the AIBE 22 hall ticket. AIBE 22 admit card: Details mentioned
 After downloading the admit card, candidates should carefully examine all the information printed on it. Any discrepancy in the personal or examination-related details should be brought to the notice of the examination authority promptly. The AIBE XXII admit card is expected to contain the following information: Candidate's name
 Roll number
 Name of the examination
 Examination centre name and address
 Examination date and time
 Reporting time
 Examination session details
 Candidate's photograph
 Candidate's signature
 Important instructions for the examination
 Candidates should pay particular attention to the examination centre address and reporting time to avoid last-minute confusion on November 29.
